narrativeProgression.description: Pastor introduces the upcoming church camping trip and its dates (May 9th-14th).
He explains that there are open spots available and encourages viewers to attend.
Pastor lists the guest pastors who will be preaching at the camp.
He instructs viewers to email him with their contact phone number if they are interested in attending.
Pastor emphasizes the need for attendees to commit to the entire week of the camp.
He reiterates the dates, encourages viewers to contact him, and assures them he will respond as soon as possible.
